nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode is explicitly responseNode (reference lesson: unset means an instant 'Workflow was started'). Set allowedOrigins to the Netlify URL.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY after import.

nodes.name: Auth: read token
nodes.notes: Uses .first() on Webhook - singleton upstream node, so no paired-item ambiguity.

nodes.name: Auth: verify token
nodes.notes: Auth check block 2/4. Supabase Auth validates the JWT (signature, expiry). neverError + fullResponse so a 401 is data for 'Auth: check role', not a crash.

nodes.name: Auth: load profile
nodes.notes: Auth check block 3/4. Reads profiles with the service role. If the token was invalid it asks for the all-zero id, which matches nothing, and 'Auth: check role' has already got the 401 from the previous node.

nodes.name: Auth: check role
nodes.notes: Every downstream node reads the caller from $('Auth: check role').first().json.user - never from the request body. client_viewer workflows must also check user.client_id against the requested resource.

nodes.name: Respond: denied
nodes.notes: Same deny node in every webhook workflow. Returns 401/403/500 with a plain message; never echoes the token or profile.

nodes.name: Draft reply (AI Agent)

options.systemMessage:
You draft a reply from Funeral Futurist (FF), a Google Ads agency, to a message a funeral home or cremation client sent in the FF dashboard. FF staff will read and edit the draft before anything is sent. Be warm, brief and clear; do not promise anything; if the client asks for a change, say FF is reviewing it, not that it is done.

Write in a calm, plain, respectful tone - these are funeral homes and cremation providers. Use plain hyphens (-), never long dashes, and no emoji. Never write personal names of families or of people who have died; if the text you were given contains [name], keep it as [name]. Only use the numbers you were given; never invent data.

proposed_action must be null UNLESS one of exactly these three changes is clearly wanted:
- "update_daily_budget": set the daily budget to a specific amount in the account currency. daily_budget is required and must be a plain number. If no amount is clear, ask a short clarifying question and leave proposed_action null.
- "pause_campaign": pause the campaign.
- "resume_campaign": resume a paused campaign.
For pause_campaign and resume_campaign set daily_budget to null. Always add a one-sentence reason. Never say a change has been made - say it is ready for Rob to confirm (only Rob can apply changes). Anything else (targeting, keywords, ad copy, questions) gets proposed_action: null and a normal answer.

nodes.notes: onError continueRegularOutput: a malformed model output must not stop the workflow (reference lesson). The next Code node treats it as no answer.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 200, body: { ok: true, id: $('Save message').first().json.id } } }];
